data.name: armors.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all armor pieces. Each entry contains name, slot (head/chest/legs), stats (physicalDefense, magicDefense, etc.), optional perk references, set bonuses, and rarity information.

data.name: blades.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all blade weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base damage values, scaling stats, element types, attack speed modifiers, and weapon-type classification.

data.name: enchantments.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all enchantments. Each entry contains name, category (refined/strengthened/dexterous/burning/etc.), stat bonuses, and slot compatibility.

data.name: essences.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all essence weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base stats, element modifiers, and weapon-type restrictions.

data.name: gloves.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all glove weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base stats, and scaling information.

data.name: guilds.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all guilds. Each entry contains name, guild ranks with stat bonuses, perk references, and description. Used to populate the guild selector in the character configuration.

data.name: handles.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all handle weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base damage, scaling stats, weapon-type modifiers, and attack properties.

data.name: perks.json
data.summary: Comprehensive static game data defining all perks. Massive dataset (3688 lines) containing every perk's name, description, tags (combat/support/status), stat bonuses, damage formulas, cooldown references, and scaling parameters. Core reference for the entire damage calculation engine.

data.name: races.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all 11 playable races. Each entry contains name, passive abilities, stat modifiers (HP, speed, elemental resistances), and racial perk references.

data.name: rings.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all ring accessories. Each entry contains name, stat bonuses, perk slots, and rarity information.

data.name: runes.json
data.summary: Static game data defining all runes. Each entry contains name, activation conditions, stat bonuses, damage effects, and cooldown properties.

config.name: .fallowrc.json
config.summary: Fallow (dead-code analyzer) configuration. Defines entry points (src/index.*, src/main.*), sets duplicate minimum occurrences to 3, enables unused-dependencies warnings, and suppresses exports from several Svelte components (AccessorySelectModal, GuildModal, WeaponPartModal, RaceModal, DidYouMean, ModalSearchHeader, TagFilter) and constants file.

config.name: fallow-output.json
config.summary: Fallow v2.102.0 dead-code analysis report. Entry points: 4 total (1 default index, 3 plugin).

file:src/data/BuffData.ts.name: BuffData.ts
file:src/data/BuffData.ts.summary: Defines buff and debuff system for the damage calculator, including buff definitions, potency calculations, duration modifiers, and active buff assembly logic.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:assembleAc.name: assembleActiveBuffs
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:assembleAc.summary: Main function that assembles all active buffs from perks, weapon arts, runes, and other sources, applying modifiers and calculating final potency and duration.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:calcBuffEf.name: calcBuffEffect
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:calcBuffEf.summary: Calculates the effect of a buff based on its potency, effect per tenth, and whether it's a percentage or flat value.

file:src/data/Perkbasedmg.ts.name: Perkbasedmg.ts
file:src/data/Perkbasedmg.ts.summary: Defines perk-based damage calculations including base damage definitions, perk damage multipliers, and special ability damage calculations for various game mechanics.

function:src/data/Perkbasedmg.ts:calcSpr.name: calcSpringblastBaseDamage
function:src/data/Perkbasedmg.ts:calcSpr.summary: Calculates base damage for the Springblast ability based on stack count and other modifiers.

function:src/data/Perkbasedmg.ts:calcBom.name: calcBomberChargeBaseDamage
function:src/data/Perkbasedmg.ts:calcBom.summary: Calculates base damage for the Bomber Charge ability based on missing HP percentage and stack count.

file:src/data/perkAutoDebuffs.ts.name: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
file:src/data/perkAutoDebuffs.ts.summary: Defines automatic debuff application logic based on perk conditions, including HP threshold checks and debuff generation for various game mechanics.

file:src/lib/constants/perk-base-damage..name: perk-base-damage.ts
file:src/lib/constants/perk-base-damage..summary: Defines base damage constants for various perk abilities and special attacks in the game.

file:src/lib/constants/storage.ts.name: storage.ts
file:src/lib/constants/storage.ts.summary: Defines storage keys and configuration for localStorage persistence of build data and user preferences.

function:src/data/perkAutoDebuffs.ts:get.name: getAutoDebuffs
function:src/data/perkAutoDebuffs.ts:get.summary: Generates automatic debuffs based on current build state, perk levels, and HP conditions.

file:src/lib/dmgTypes.ts.name: dmgTypes.ts
file:src/lib/dmgTypes.ts.summary: Defines damage type badge configurations and display constants for the damage analyzer UI.

file:src/lib/store.ts.name: store.ts
file:src/lib/store.ts.summary: Svelte store module managing build state persistence, enchantment manipulation, guild/race configuration, and armor/ring slot reordering. Exports reactive stores and updater functions that form the central state management layer for the Voxel Blade damage calculator.

function:src/lib/store.ts:loadBuild.name: loadBuild
function:src/lib/store.ts:loadBuild.summary: Loads the persisted BuildState from localStorage, merges it with defaults via spread operator, and returns a complete BuildState. Uses defensive try/catch to fall back to defaults on parse errors or missing data.

function:src/lib/store.ts:setEnchantment.name: setEnchantment
function:src/lib/store.ts:setEnchantment.summary: Sets a single enchantment value at a given index within a specified armor slot. Delegates constraint enforcement (e.g. no duplicate enchantments) to the engine's enforceEnchantSlot function.

function:src/lib/store.ts:swapEnchantmen.name: swapEnchantments
function:src/lib/store.ts:swapEnchantmen.summary: Swaps the entire enchantment arrays between two different armor slots. Short-circuits if both slots are the same.

function:src/lib/store.ts:clearBuild.name: clearBuild
function:src/lib/store.ts:clearBuild.summary: Resets the entire build state to the DEFAULT_BUILD constant, effectively restoring all equipment, enchantments, and settings to initial values.

function:src/lib/store.ts:setGuild.name: setGuild
function:src/lib/store.ts:setGuild.summary: Sets the guild name and rank. Automatically forces the race to 'DRAGON BLOODED' and initializes draconic color if the guild is 'Draconic'; clears draconic fields otherwise.

function:src/lib/store.ts:moveArmorSlot.name: moveArmorSlot
function:src/lib/store.ts:moveArmorSlot.summary: Moves or clones an armor piece between a primary slot (helmet/chestplate/leggings) and its infusion counterpart. Validates slot compatibility via armorSupportsSlot, swaps or copies the upgrade level, and returns whether the move succeeded.

function:src/lib/store.ts:canArmorMoveTo.name: canArmorMoveToSlot
function:src/lib/store.ts:canArmorMoveTo.summary: Predicate that checks whether a given armor name is compatible with a target slot type (Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings) by delegating to armorSupportsSlot.

function:src/lib/store.ts:moveRingSlot.name: moveRingSlot
function:src/lib/store.ts:moveRingSlot.summary: Moves or clones a ring between the primary ring slot and its infusion counterpart, including the associated upgrade level. Follows the same clone-or-swap pattern as moveArmorSlot.

file:src/lib/constants/boosts.ts.summary: Defines boost constants and multipliers for various damage calculation mechanics.

file:src/lib/constants/cdr.ts.summary: Cooldown reduction constant definitions for CDR-related perks (Caster, Channeled Weapon, Mage Rage, Poison Acceleration, Whirlwind, etc.).

file:src/lib/uiConstants.ts.summary: Defines UI color constants and source labels for the damage analyzer display components.

file:src/data/Weaponartcheck.ts.name: Weaponartcheck.ts
file:src/data/Weaponartcheck.ts.summary: Validates whether a weapon art's requirements (scaling, stats, weapon type, guild, both-parts) are met by the current build, and produces human-readable lists of unmet requirements.

file:src/data/weaponArts.ts.name: weaponArts.ts
file:src/data/weaponArts.ts.summary: Defines the WeaponArt and WeaponArtRequirement interfaces and the WEAPON_ARTS data array containing all weapon art definitions with their names, descriptions, cooldowns, damage, scaling, hits, and requirements.

file:src/lib/constants/damage-types.ts.name: damage-types.ts
file:src/lib/constants/damage-types.ts.summary: Defines all damage type metadata (labels, colors), defense inheritance mappings, type priority ordering, and exported constant arrays for the game's 11 damage types (physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, hex, holy, true, summon, heal).

file:src/lib/damageTypeResolve.ts.name: damageTypeResolve.ts
file:src/lib/damageTypeResolve.ts.summary: Resolves weapon art damage types from string descriptions into numeric type maps, applies type bonuses, and performs damage type conversions (Fire<->Air via Echo Incineration, Air->Magic via Spirit Winds, Dark Magic hex bonus).

file:src/lib/engine/_utils.ts.name: _utils.ts
file:src/lib/engine/_utils.ts.summary: Minimal utility module exporting round2 and round4 functions for numeric rounding with epsilon correction, used throughout the engine layer.

file:src/lib/engine/build.ts.name: build.ts
file:src/lib/engine/build.ts.summary: Core build calculation engine: accumulates stats and perks from all equipment slots (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon), applies enchantments and infusions, finalizes perks with effectiveness scaling, computes CDR, boosts, crit, and assembles active buffs. Exports calcBuild as the main entry point.

file:src/lib/engine/data.ts.name: data.ts
file:src/lib/engine/data.ts.summary: Barrel re-export module that re-exports all symbols from character, equipment, and weapon data sub-modules, providing a single import point for game data accessors.

file:src/lib/engine/enchant.ts.name: enchant.ts
file:src/lib/engine/enchant.ts.summary: Enchantment application engine: applies stat-selecting enchantments (Restored, Flawless), direct stat modifiers, perk modifiers, perk effectiveness scaling, infusion (50% stat halving), and exclusive enchant slot enforcement.

file:src/lib/engine/format.ts.name: format.ts
file:src/lib/engine/format.ts.summary: Formatting utilities for stat display: formats numeric stat values with +/- signs, percentage suffixes for percent-type stats, and converts camelCase stat keys to readable labels.

file:src/lib/engine/shrine.ts.name: shrine.ts
file:src/lib/engine/shrine.ts.summary: Shrine multiplier system: defines tier-based stat multipliers (3.0x at tier 1 down to 1.0x at tier 5) and applies them to weapon stats and scalings when the shrine is active.

file:src/lib/engine/weapon.ts.name: weapon.ts
file:src/lib/engine/weapon.ts.summary: Weapon calculation engine: combines blade/handle (or glove/essence for monk) stats, scalings, damage types, and perks; resolves weapon type from handle+blade combo with perk overrides; detects hybrid bonus; applies shrine multipliers and monk rank bonuses. Exports calcWeapon and calcMonkWeapon.

file:src/data/Boost.ts.name: Boost.ts
file:src/data/Boost.ts.summary: Defines the damage boost calculation system for the Voxel Blade build calculator. Contains BoostDef/BoostContext interfaces and a comprehensive BOOST_DEFS array of 30+ damage boosts (Blood Thirsty, Frenzy, Primal, Penance, Vampire, etc.), each with either simple multiplier-per-perk values or complex custom calcFn closures. Also exports helper functions calcMinionAbsorptionPotency and calcFrenzyPct, and Penance bleed constants.

file:src/data/debuffCombatEffects.ts.name: debuffCombatEffects.ts
file:src/data/debuffCombatEffects.ts.summary: Defines the combat effects applied by debuffs on enemies. Exports a DEBUFF_COMBAT_EFFECTS record mapping debuff names (Weakness, Shatter, Sticky variants, Electrical Rend, Despair, Frostbite, Hypnotized) to DebuffCombatEffect objects containing description generators, damage multipliers, defense reductions, and element-specific damage multipliers.

file:src/data/enemyHpEffects.ts.name: enemyHpEffects.ts
file:src/data/enemyHpEffects.ts.summary: Defines HP-gated enemy effects that trigger based on enemy current HP percentage. Contains interfaces for HP gates, debuff effects, and DoT boosts, plus a static ENEMY_HP_EFFECT_DEFS array (currently Mycotic Bloom). Exports functions getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs and getEnemyHpDotMultiplier to evaluate which effects are active given the current enemy HP and active debuffs.

file:src/lib/constants/debuff-effects.ts.name: debuff-effects.ts
file:src/lib/constants/debuff-effects.ts.summary: Small constants file defining numeric multipliers used by debuff combat effects. Contains the Sticky damage multiplier (1.2x), Despair display divisor/coefficient for UI formatting, and Despair damage coefficient (0.085).

file:src/lib/constants/game.ts.name: game.ts
file:src/lib/constants/game.ts.summary: Core game constants serving as the single source of truth for game-wide values. Defines level caps (MAX_LEVEL=80, DEFAULT_LEVEL=80), HP formula constants (BASE_HP=120, HP_PER_LEVEL=0.0125) with calcBaseMaxHP function, default fill percentages, and timing constants for UI operations (save debounce, undo window, search blur delay, toast duration, etc.).

file:src/lib/constants/perks.ts.name: perks.ts
file:src/lib/constants/perks.ts.summary: Contains perk-specific numeric constants used across the damage engine. Covers crit base values (BASE_CRIT_DAMAGE=150), crit rate multipliers for various perks (Flowing Crits, Spell Slinger, Sharp Crits, etc.), crit damage formulas (Thief Training, Venom Eater, Vital Strikes, etc.), element multipliers (Luminescent, Spirit Winds, Dark Magic, etc.), and combat mechanic values (Sunburn, Frostbite, Fiery Pursuit, Hypnotist, Phantom Pain).

file::.github/workflows/static.yml.name: static.yml
file::.github/workflows/static.yml.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds the Vite project and deploys static assets to GitHub Pages on push to main or manual dispatch.

pipeline::.github/workflows/static.yml::.name: build
pipeline::.github/workflows/static.yml::.summary: CI job that checks out the repo, sets up Node 24, installs dependencies, runs the Vite build, and uploads the dist/ directory as a Pages artifact.

pipeline::.github/workflows/static.yml::.name: deploy
pipeline::.github/workflows/static.yml::.summary: CI job that depends on the build job and deploys the uploaded artifact to GitHub Pages using actions/deploy-pages@v5.

schema::src/data/armors.json.name: armors.json
schema::src/data/armors.json.summary: Static game data defining all armor pieces. Each entry contains name, slot (head/chest/legs), stats (physicalDefense, magicDefense, etc.), optional perk references, set bonuses, and rarity information.

schema::src/data/blades.json.name: blades.json
schema::src/data/blades.json.summary: Static game data defining all blade weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base damage values, scaling stats, element types, attack speed modifiers, and weapon-type classification.

schema::src/data/enchantments.json.name: enchantments.json
schema::src/data/enchantments.json.summary: Static game data defining all enchantments. Each entry contains name, category (refined/strengthened/dexterous/burning/etc.), stat bonuses, and slot compatibility.

schema::src/data/essences.json.name: essences.json
schema::src/data/essences.json.summary: Static game data defining all essence weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base stats, element modifiers, and weapon-type restrictions.

schema::src/data/gloves.json.name: gloves.json
schema::src/data/gloves.json.summary: Static game data defining all glove weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base stats, and scaling information.

schema::src/data/guilds.json.name: guilds.json
schema::src/data/guilds.json.summary: Static game data defining all guilds. Each entry contains name, guild ranks with stat bonuses, perk references, and description. Used to populate the guild selector in the character configuration.

schema::src/data/handles.json.name: handles.json
schema::src/data/handles.json.summary: Static game data defining all handle weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base damage, scaling stats, weapon-type modifiers, and attack properties.

schema::src/data/perks.json.name: perks.json
schema::src/data/perks.json.summary: Comprehensive static game data defining all perks. Massive dataset (3688 lines) containing every perk's name, description, tags (combat/support/status), stat bonuses, damage formulas, cooldown references, and scaling parameters. Core reference for the entire damage calculation engine.

schema::src/data/races.json.name: races.json
schema::src/data/races.json.summary: Static game data defining all 11 playable races. Each entry contains name, passive abilities, stat modifiers (HP, speed, elemental resistances), and racial perk references.

schema::src/data/rings.json.name: rings.json
schema::src/data/rings.json.summary: Static game data defining all ring accessories. Each entry contains name, stat bonuses, perk slots, and rarity information.

schema::src/data/runes.json.name: runes.json
schema::src/data/runes.json.summary: Static game data defining all runes. Each entry contains name, activation conditions, stat bonuses, damage effects, and cooldown properties.

file::src/lib/modals/AccessorySelectModa.summary: Modal (200 lines) for selecting ring or rune accessories. Uses ModalSearchHeader for search/filter and displays items in a grid with stat previews.

file::src/lib/modals/GuildModal.svelte.summary: Modal (98 lines) for selecting a guild. Lists available guilds with rank progression and stat bonus previews.

file::src/lib/modals/index.ts.summary: Barrel re-export file (4 lines) exporting RaceModal, GuildModal, AccessorySelectModal, and WeaponPartModal.

file::src/lib/modals/RaceModal.svelte.summary: Modal (60 lines) for selecting a character race. Lists available races with passive ability descriptions.

file::src/lib/modals/WeaponPartModal.sve.summary: Modal (137 lines) for selecting weapon parts (blades, handles, gloves, essences). Uses ModalSearchHeader with stat filtering and weapon stat comparison.

file::src/lib/StatFilterShared.svelte.summary: Shared Svelte component (97 lines) providing StatChip UI and buildStatMaps utility used by both StatFilter and WeaponStatFilter. Renders stat filter chips with include/exclude toggle states.
